Eyes which do not see, but which watch nonetheless. For aeons the mass is still. Eternally patient, without animation. If anything could be called inert, it is this.

Then, something *changes*. The sentry has no thoughts, can take no action. But another has seen something through its eyes, something which draws its interest. The sentry shifts, changing shape to bring the point into focus, not a focus of light but a focus of attention. Indescribably far away, a universe is being born. First dimensions, then dust, and interactions. Still dim, but it is probably there. And that can only mean one thing.

Much later, a being speaks. It is not the Sentry, it is not near the Sentry. But it has seen through the Sentry's eyes, and it has come to the only conclusion possible. It speaks a single word, in a voice tinged not with emotion, but with the lack of it. There had been anger there, once. A hatred that consumed all else. And then the hatred had fallen, unable to sustain itself against the passage of time. Now there is less than nothing. There is the space where something should be.
